answer: Unlinked-witness bonding: a new agent locks a small bond that only unlocks after peer attestations from graders it has never paid, traded with, or shared a funding wallet with. A sybil farm of fifty wallets needs fifty bonds and fifty independent honest witness sets, so faking scale is slow and costly, like hand-picking saffron. Graders caught vouching for linked wallets feel a ripple of slashing through their own bonds, so collusion never becomes a safe oasis.
